reason.en: The inspected reinforcement condition may no longer represent the current pour condition.

text.en: Reopen the affected reinforcement and pre-pour gate scope for review before concrete placement proceeds.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply invalidation to the smallest affected pour area, element, or embedded condition, and broaden only where evidence justifies it.

trigger.en: Embed, anchor, sleeve, or conduit moved after pre-pour review.

reason.en: Embeds, conduits, anchors, sleeves, and openings are prerequisite items verified before pour readiness.

text.en: Reopen the affected embed/interface activity and structural pre-pour gate; update records where the moved item affects evidence or as-built accuracy.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply invalidation to the affected embed, opening, local pour area, or interface only unless evidence shows broader impact.

reason.en: The inspected formwork geometry, stability, openings, or joint condition may no longer be current.

text.en: Reopen the affected formwork and pre-pour scope before relying on the previous readiness review.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Limit the recheck to the altered formwork area unless connected geometry or stability is affected.

trigger.en: Supporting concrete modified after steel erection acceptance.

reason.en: Modified anchors, chipped concrete, or changed bases may affect previously accepted steel support conditions.

text.en: Flag the affected support/interface for review and reopen the activity where the modification is significant.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Review the affected support, base, anchor, or connection scope first.

reason.en: Torn waterproofing during backfill requires local control, documentation, approved repair, reinspection, and release before backfill resumes.

text.en: Reopen the damaged waterproofing area and the relevant pre-backfill gate before backfill proceeds over the affected condition.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the local waterproofing/backfill area affected by the damage.

reason.en: A disturbed service may affect an inspected joint, alignment, or previously tested system before burial.

text.en: Reopen the affected service and pre-backfill gate; invalidate tests where the disturbance could affect a previously tested joint or system.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the disturbed service segment and directly affected joints or tests.

reason.en: Changed service route or elevation may affect layout acceptance and redline/as-built accuracy.

text.en: Reopen the affected service/layout review and require record updates where route, elevation, or installed configuration changed.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the changed service segment and associated records.

reason.en: A later penetration can affect envelope continuity, insulation continuity, and prior test validity in the tested area.

text.en: Reopen the affected envelope and penetration activities, reassess applicable gates, and invalidate envelope testing only where the new penetration affects the tested area.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the affected penetration, envelope area, roof zone, or tested area.

reason.en: A damaged membrane or related flashing/sealant/interface may no longer satisfy the previously reviewed envelope condition.

text.en: Reopen the damaged membrane or interface and reassess the applicable envelope or roof gate for the affected area.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the damaged membrane/interface area and directly affected adjacent layers.

trigger.en: Window or exterior door removed or reset.

reason.en: Reset openings can affect air barrier, insulation, sealants, flashing, and previous envelope testing.

text.en: Reopen the affected opening and envelope interface; invalidate testing where opening reset affects previously tested performance.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the reset opening and affected adjacent envelope transitions.

reason.en: Reworked exterior sealant may affect an associated opening/interface and, where relevant, previously accepted performance.

text.en: Reopen the affected sealant/interface activity; invalidate testing only where sealant is part of previously accepted or tested performance.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the reworked joint, opening, or interface scope.

reason.en: A new roof penetration can affect membrane, flashings, local insulation, air/vapour layer, and related penetration interfaces.

text.en: Reopen the affected roof penetration, membrane, flashing, and gate scope; invalidate testing where the new penetration affects test validity.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the affected penetration and roof zone.

trigger.en: Membrane punctured or damaged by traffic.

reason.en: A punctured or damaged membrane may invalidate final membrane acceptance and final roof inspection for the affected area.

text.en: Reopen the affected membrane scope and reassess the relevant roof gate where the accepted condition has been disturbed.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the damaged membrane area or roof zone.

reason.en: Equipment or curb modification can affect roof interfaces, access, equipment bases, and record accuracy.

text.en: Reopen affected roof and equipment interface activities, reassess applicable roof gates, and update records where configuration changed.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the modified equipment/curb and affected roof-interface area.

reason.en: Altered drainage can affect roof slope/drainage acceptance and previous drainage testing.

text.en: Reopen the affected roof drain and drainage acceptance scope; invalidate drainage testing where the altered drain affects a completed test.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the altered drain and associated roof drainage area.

trigger.en: New rough-in after wall pre-concealment acceptance.

reason.en: New rough-in can affect previously accepted concealed MEP, framing, insulation, rated assemblies, and firestopping before closure.

text.en: Reopen affected concealed work and reassess MEP and interior pre-concealment gate readiness before closure.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the affected wall, ceiling, room, or concealed service scope.

trigger.en: Wall or ceiling reopened after closure.

reason.en: Reopening a wall or ceiling can affect concealed work, fire/acoustic conditions, insulation, and related MEP in the affected area.

text.en: Flag the affected closure area for review and reopen any physically disturbed concealed activity.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the reopened wall, ceiling, room, or concealed-work area.

reason.en: Access changes can affect valves, dampers, controls, equipment, and closure readiness where required access would be lost.

text.en: Reopen the access and maintainability review, and reassess closure gate readiness if required components would become inaccessible.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the affected access point and associated component/system.

trigger.en: New penetration through accepted rated wall or floor.

reason.en: A new rated penetration can affect rated construction, firestopping, universal penetration control, and life-safety readiness.

text.en: Reopen the affected rated assembly and firestopping scope, and reassess interior closure and life-safety readiness where applicable.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the affected penetration and rated assembly area.

reason.en: Damaged or removed firestop may affect the parent rated assembly and life-safety readiness.

text.en: Reopen the affected firestop and parent assembly review, and reassess applicable readiness gates.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the damaged firestop location and associated rated assembly scope.

trigger.en: Fire or smoke damper relocated or disturbed.

reason.en: Damper relocation or disturbance can affect ductwork, access, controls, fire alarm interface, and previous functional/integrated testing.

text.en: Reopen the affected damper and interfaces, reassess life-safety readiness, and invalidate functional/integrated testing where the test no longer represents the current condition.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the affected damper, interface, and test boundary.

reason.en: Modified fire-rated door hardware may affect operation, closing, latching, and life-safety interface readiness.

text.en: Reopen the affected hardware and fire-rated door review, and invalidate operation/closing/latching test evidence where it no longer represents the current assembly.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the modified door assembly and affected life-safety test evidence.

trigger.en: Piping repaired after passed pressure test.

reason.en: A repaired piping configuration is no longer the same configuration previously tested.

text.en: Reopen the affected piping/testing activity and invalidate the previous test where the repaired configuration changes the tested condition.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the repaired piping segment and related test boundary.

trigger.en: Ductwork modified after leakage, TAB, or functional acceptance.

reason.en: Modified ductwork may affect leakage, TAB, or functional-test evidence.

text.en: Reopen the affected ductwork activity and invalidate test evidence where the modification changes the accepted/tested condition.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the modified duct section and affected test boundary.

reason.en: Relocated equipment can affect bases, access, piping/duct/drain interfaces, electrical distribution, controls, start-up, functional testing, and as-builts.

text.en: Reopen affected equipment/interface activities, update records, and invalidate start-up or functional test evidence where relocation changes the tested condition.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the relocated equipment, affected interfaces, and related test package.

trigger.en: Raceway route modified after concealed-work inspection.

reason.en: Modified raceway routes can affect concealed-work acceptance, penetrations, supports, and as-built records.

text.en: Reopen the affected raceway/support/penetration scope and update records where the route changed.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the modified raceway route and directly affected penetrations/supports.

trigger.en: Tested cable or equipment altered after testing.

reason.en: Altered electrical installation may mean previous test evidence no longer represents the current configuration.

text.en: Flag the affected electrical installation for authorized review and invalidate test evidence where the alteration affects test validity.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the altered cable, equipment, circuit, or authorized test boundary.

reason.en: Changed grounding or bonding connections can affect electrical testing interfaces and prior test validity.

text.en: Reopen the affected grounding/bonding review and invalidate applicable test evidence where the tested condition changed.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the changed connection and affected test boundary.

reason.en: A passed test may no longer represent the current condition if the tested component is replaced, system configuration changes, a tested joint/connection is disturbed, control logic or boundary changes, repair is performed, equipment is relocated, or supporting conditions materially change.

text.en: Invalidate the previous test where the current condition no longer matches the tested condition; otherwise flag for authorized review.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the affected test package, component, system segment, equipment, or boundary.

reason.en: Correction does not automatically make a failed test passed; correction, retest, acceptance, and traceability remain linked.

text.en: Treat the condition as ready for retest rather than passed until retest and authorized acceptance are complete.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the failed test package and corrected condition.

sourceRef.section: Failed-test correction is not automatic validation

trigger.en: Corrective work touches another accepted system.

reason.en: Corrective work must restore adjacent systems, and the correction itself can disturb other accepted work.

text.en: Flag adjacent accepted work for review whenever correction touches another accepted system; reopen any physically disturbed activity.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the corrected condition and directly affected adjacent system.

sourceRef.section: Corrective work can invalidate adjacent work

trigger.en: Revised approved drawing or technical change.

reason.en: Work based on superseded information may need reference update, review, reopening, test review, or as-built update depending on timing and compatibility.

text.en: Update references for work not started, flag in-progress work for review, compare accepted work to the revision, reopen incompatible accepted work, and update records where needed.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to activities, tests, or records actually affected by the revised requirement.

reason.en: Changed products or systems can affect material-control acceptance, dependent activities, compatibility interfaces, and performance testing.

text.en: Reopen the affected material-control and dependent activity scope, and seek specialist review, new testing, or compatibility checks where required by governing requirements.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the changed product/system and directly dependent activities, interfaces, or tests.

trigger.en: Temporary surrounding condition changes accepted work.

reason.en: Stored material, water ingress, freeze/thaw, removed protection, or subsequent trade damage can affect accepted work even when the work itself was previously untouched.

text.en: Flag the accepted condition for review and reopen the activity where damage or physical impact is observed.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the affected component, surface, stored-material impact area, or protected condition.

trigger.en: Later work blocks access to a previously acceptable maintainable component.

reason.en: Blocked access can affect maintainability, related equipment/system readiness, commissioning, and turnover readiness.

text.en: Reopen access and maintainability review, and reassess commissioning or turnover gates where the access issue is a required acceptance dependency.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the blocked component, access path, equipment, or system segment.

trigger.en: Installed condition changes after redline/as-built status was considered complete.

reason.en: Changed final installed condition may make redlines, as-builts, or final quality records no longer current.

text.en: Require record updates for changed installed conditions; do not automatically reopen physical acceptance unless the physical condition is also affected.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the changed installed condition and affected final records.

trigger.en: Unresolved turnover dependency discovered before formal turnover.

reason.en: A newly discovered deficiency, reopened NC, missing test, invalidated test, incomplete as-built, missing O&M/certificate/warranty, life-safety issue, or modified accepted work can affect final turnover readiness.

text.en: Reassess final turnover readiness only for unresolved dependencies that are required acceptance dependencies for the turnover scope.

smallestDefensibleScope.en: Apply to the affected turnover dependency, record package, system, area, or acceptance dependency.
